response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong alignment with the Staff Software Engineer role, particularly in distributed systems, AI-driven development, and technical strategy. His current work at re:cinq on AI-agent infrastructure and full-stack engineering, combined with his experience in high-throughput systems and operational ownership, makes him a compelling candidate. However, his exposure to AI-native environments is recent, and his stakeholder management experience could be further validated.
strengths: Proven expertise in distributed systems and high-throughput architectures (e.g., Dunnhumby media, RIDE Capital).
Hands-on experience with AI-driven engineering (re:cinq) and developer tooling for agentic workflows.
Operational ownership mindset with full-stack development and on-call readiness (e.g., Optilyz, Altom Consulting).
concerns: Limited explicit evidence of deep stakeholder management across product/leadership functions.
Recent transition to AI-native environments; prior experience is more traditional full-stack.
No clear mention of agile ceremony leadership (e.g., scrum champion rotation).
